skills.description: You can wield Dexterity weapons in both hands that you are proficient in.
Shooting an enemy within 10ft always results in a headshot.
After landing a melee attack, add 5 feet to your movement speed next turn.
You can recover your health and willpower on a short rest and are resistant (take half damage) to environmental damage.
